newsitem.title: USA: Maine gov to propose new cap on state, local taxes.
newsitem.headline: Maine gov to propose new cap on state, local taxes.

text.p: Maine Gov Angus King is expected to unveil this week a plan to control state and local taxes by tying them to the growth in individual income.

King, who is calling the plan the "mother of all tax caps," says his goal is to reduce from 12.3 percent to less than 11 percent the percentage of personal income spent in Maine on state and local taxes.
King says if the state does not ease its tax burden, it will not be able to compete in a new global economy.
